{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers, and exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
loyal_df = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Also exclude refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
loyal_valid = loyal_df[loyal_df['status'] != 'refunded']

# Compute conversion fraction
n_loyal_valid = loyal_valid.shape[0]
converted_loyal_valid = loyal_valid['converted'].sum()
conversion_fraction = converted_loyal_valid / n_loyal_valid

# Print results
print(f'Valid loyal customers (excl. QA and refunded): {n_loyal_valid}')
print(f'Converted among valid loyal: {converted_loyal_valid}')
print(f'Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}')"}
